meta.corpus: wikitext103 test windows, decoded to text with the OLMo-2 tokenizer (data/ood_ppl/wikitext103_test.npy); 4500 words scanned per model before intersection
meta.pooling: MEAN over the subword tokens whose character span overlaps the word (fast-tokenizer offset mapping); add_special_tokens=False; one text per forward so NO padding tokens ever enter the pool; use_cache=False
meta.dtype: model fp32, CKA accumulations fp64, TF32 disabled
meta.zcka_definition: per-dimension z-score (mean/std over the word axis) of each [N,D] matrix, then linear CKA. Identical to smoke_stitch_cpu.py::zscore + cka_matrix_gpu -> directly comparable to R3.
meta.midband_definition: mean of the z-CKA matrix over the block {i: i/L_a in [0.25,0.75]} x {j: j/L_b in [0.25,0.75]} (verified to reproduce R3)
differences_from_R3: global word-key INTERSECTION over all models (R3 asserted exact equality, impossible across 7 tokenizer families)
uniform N words for every pair (R3: 4000 for the 1B triple, 3000 for the 7B/8B pairs)

nonparametric_u_geometry.why: the quadratic is a summary; these do not assume any shape

distance_control.why: if CKA merely decayed with |i/L_a - j/L_b| the relative-depth diagonal (where that distance is ~0 by construction) would be FLAT, not U-shaped. Two checks: (1) max distance anywhere on the diagonal, (2) refit the quadratic on residuals after regressing every matrix entry on a cubic in that distance.

H2_depth_vs_family.verdict_criterion: H2 holds iff log_depth_ratio coef is negative and significant AND |std effect of log_depth_ratio| >= |std effect of same_family|

diag_min_zcka.note: the mid-depth WORST point of the diagonal, i.e. the number that matters if you want to stitch at mid depth

null_layer_order_shuffle.note: permutes B's layer ORDER; tests whether the midband block is special, NOT the CKA magnitude floor (which is the random-init control)
